description: Change what an import will do, and read its new dry run in `preview`. `mapping` replaces the whole mapping; a setting you don't send stays as it is. Pass the `revision` you read: if the import changed since, nothing is saved and it answers 409 serverErrors.importStale, with the current revision in `details.revision`. A change moves the revision up by one. Send only `revision` to run the dry run again, for example after you made room on your plan. `preview.blockers` lists what would stop a commit now.

hasHeader.description: Whether row 1 holds column names rather than a contact.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

label.description: The label every contact in the file gets: one you have, by id, or a name. A name is matched to your labels with case ignored, and made when you commit if it's new. Send null for no label.

mapping.description: Every column that goes somewhere. A column left out is not imported. A mapping the import can't use answers 400 serverErrors.importMapping, one detail per entry.

column.description: The column, counted from 0: A is 0, B is 1.

customKey.description: The custom field's name, with target custom only: letters, numbers and underscores, words joined by spaces or dashes.

target.description: What this column fills. email: the address, in one column only. name: a whole name; the first word becomes the first name, the rest the last name. firstName, lastName, company, phone: those fields. unsubscribed: Do not email; a yes, a date or a word like unsubscribed marks the contact Do not email, a no or a blank changes nothing, and anything else counts as a yes, to be safe. verdict: another tool's check of the address, such as valid or catch-all. checkedAt: when that tool checked it, written like 2024-01-15; needs a verdict column. labels: label names, one per line in the cell, as the contacts file writes them; a name matches a label you have with case ignored, and a new one is made when you commit. custom: a custom field named by customKey.

mode.description: What happens to a contact you already have. skip, the default, keeps its details as they are. update fills them in from the file, and a blank cell never erases anything. Either way the contact gets the label, and a Do not email in the file still applies.

revision.description: The revision you read. If the import changed since, nothing is saved and it answers 409 serverErrors.importStale, with the current revision in details.revision.
